title: ONE CORNER PANEL LOOK
why: The critic on screens 47, 48 and 51: every corner has a differently shaped box. The ammo and gun panels had a cut corner, the plates had no line. Both now draw the same fill, 1px line and 4px radius.
now: The raid hud panels (score, ammo, log rows, controls) all share one fill, one border and 4px round corners.
